const HandleRotationChange=(e,initialTranslate,initialScale,dimensions)=>{const rotationDegree=e.target.value;document.getElementById('rotation_value').value=rotationDegree;const svgElement=document.querySelector("#right_column svg g");if(svgElement){const currentTransform=svgElement.getAttribute("transform")||"";const translateMatch=currentTransform.match(/translate\(([^)]+)\)/);const scaleMatch=currentTransform.match(/scale\(([^)]+)\)/);const translate=translateMatch?translateMatch[1]:initialTranslate;const scale=scaleMatch?scaleMatch[1]:initialScale;svgElement.setAttribute("transform",`translate(${translate}) scale(${scale}) rotate(${rotationDegree}, ${dimensions.width/2}, ${dimensions.height/2})`);}};export default HandleRotationChange;
